messages:
elena: quick design review request for Security > Audit & Retention. small UX + a11y nits around retention copy, region selector ordering, and KMS badging. can folks scan? :eyes:
alex: show me the screens plz. link?
elena: putting screenshots in Figma: https://redwood.mock/figma/console-sec-2026. go to Audit & Retention panel -> details.
priya: read-through: KMS badge currently just 'KMS' in caps. users aren't sure if it's managed by us or them. propose badge text: 'Customer-managed key (KMS)' with tooltip: 'Keys are managed in your cloud KMS; Redwood does not store key material.'
jamie: agree. contrast for that badge bg is low (~3.8:1). need to hit 4.5:1 for normal text. suggest darker bg or 1px darker border + swap text to bold 600. I'll add tokens. :a11y:
chris: audit table header 'Actor' feels terse. Suggest primary label 'Performed by' plus tooltip 'User or service account that initiated this event' — will help screen readers and context.
alex: retention label currently reads 'Data retention: 90' (no units). change to 'Data retention: 90 days'. helper line should be explicit: 'Logs are retained for 90 days and then permanently removed.' note: legal approved 'permanently removed' for audit logs but not for backups.
elena: good — keep that phrasing but mark exceptions in backup flows. also the dropdown default option is 'Global default (90)'. change to 'Global default (90 days)'. set select aria-label to 'Select retention period (days)'.
priya: for i18n, i'll put the helper in a param'd string: i18n.security.retention = 'Logs are retained for {days} days and then permanently removed.' will add unit tests.
jamie: region selector usability: it's currently alphabetical by region code. PM wants user's primary region first, then a 'Recommended' grouping, then the rest. keyboard focus jumps to end after confirm — we should keep focus on the control and announce selection change with an aria-live region. also ensure the popup is reachable with keyboard only.
chris: encryption row has two decorative icons inline (padlock + shield). NVDA reads both labels making it noisy. mark icons aria-hidden="true" and include a visually-hidden string 'Encryption: Customer-managed key' in the DOM for screen readers.
elena: microcopy batch to paste in the design file: 1) Badge: 'Customer-managed key (KMS)' 2) Badge tooltip: 'Keys are managed in your cloud KMS. Redwood does not persist key material.' 3) Retention label: 'Data retention: 90 days' 4) Retention helper: 'Logs are retained for 90 days and then permanently removed.' 5) Audit header: 'Performed by' + tooltip 'User or service account that initiated this event' 6) Region note: 'Recommended regions appear first based on account settings.'
alex: i'll update Figma + tokens and do a contrast tweak. will ping design-bot when done.
priya: component change plan: update select placeholder, aria-label, and i18n keys in components repo. add unit tests to ensure days unit present.
jamie: I'll test with VoiceOver & NVDA after changes land and report any remaining issues. will check keyboard only ordering for region list too.
chris: legal question: confirm they signed off on 'permanently removed' for audit logs specifically?
elena: yes legal OK for audit logs. i'll note backup exceptions in the ticket.
design-bot: checklist: added items -> KMS badge copy, badge contrast, retention copy units, audit header tooltip, region selector a11y, aria-live announcement. linked to ticket SEC-4212.
elena: thanks all. scheduling a 15m sync after PRs land. :thumbsup:
